mapper.sql: id, name, http_method, path_pattern, roles, priority, enabled, builtin, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission_rule (name, http_method, path_pattern, roles, priority, enabled, builtin, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{httpMethod}, #{pathPattern}, #{roles}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, #{builtin}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE permission_rule SET name = #{name}, http_method = #{httpMethod}, path_pattern = #{pathPattern}, roles = #{roles}, priority = #{priority}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM permission_rule ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
